title: String Index Search

lines.explanation: take a string input from the user and store it in the variable 'mystring'

lines.code: mysym = input ("Enter symbold to search for?")
lines.explanation: taking the symbol (character) as input and storing it in the variable 'mysym'
this statement checks if the symbol or the character given as input from user is in the string
if yes, it will print out the index where that symbol appears in the string. Not the use of an inbuilt method index()
if the symbol is not found in the string, then it wil print out a nice error message saying that the symbols id not in the given string
